area: JBR (Roxy Cinema building area) and City Walk

avoid_dishes.dish: Benedicts on muffins, waffles, French toast, regular pancakes

name: Eggspectation
questions: Do you have gluten-free bread or English muffins? Any oat flour in them?
Is the hollandaise made from scratch, with no flour or mix?
Are the potatoes pan-fried or deep-fried in a shared fryer?
quinoa_oat_flags: Breakfast menus like this usually include granola, oatmeal or porridge. Avoid them.

safe_dishes.dish: Egg dishes made to order without gluten
safe_dishes.note: What's On and Bayut say they will adapt dishes for GF diners on request.

summary: Undated What's On and Bayut roundups say staff make dishes to order for GF diners, but it is not a GF-focused place and I found no recent celiac reviews.
